newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to build $67 mln Casablanca slaughterhouse.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to build $67 mln Casablanca slaughterhouse.

text.p: Morocco plans to build a new slaughterhouse in Casablanca at a cost of $67 million with an output of 57,000 tonnes of beef and lamb meat per year, an official at the interior ministry said on Saturday.
"An envelope of $67 million was devoted to the construction of the Casablanca new slaughterhouse, of which 85 percent to be invested in machinery and other equipment," the official said.
Half the total amount will be provided by the Spanish government, the ministry said but gave no details.
The slaughterhouse will be operational in the first half of 1999.
